label: Charging and error alerts
info:
## Charging and error alerts

Sends a short alert when charging starts or stops, when a boost starts or ends, when any `*_error` field gets a value, changes or clears, and when Octopus posts a new alert for your car or charge point.

**Inputs it reads:** `charging_now`, `boosting`, every field ending in `_error` (for example `intelligent_error`, `applicable_rates_error`, `boost_error`, `smartflex_vehicle_error`), `device_alerts`, `confirmed_limit`, `confirmed_time`, `next_start_locale`.

**Output:** one message per change, with a title in `msg.topic` and the text in `msg.payload`.

**Setup**

1. Choose which alerts you want with the switches at the top of **Spot changes**.
2. Replace the debug node with your notifier, for example email, Pushover, Telegram or ntfy.
3. The rate limit node lets one alert through every 10 seconds, so a burst after an outage arrives as a short queue rather than all at once.
4. The first message after a deploy or restart only sets the baseline, so you are not sent alerts for things that were already true.

**Wiring to your Octopus Intelligent node**

This flow has no Octopus node of its own. Use the one you already have: each node polls Octopus by itself, so several nodes on one account multiply your API use and can hit Octopus's rate limits.

1. Add a **link out** node after your Octopus Intelligent node and wire the node's output to it.
2. Open that link out and tick **From Octopus node** on this tab.

If your node is on the same tab, you can delete the link nodes and wire it directly instead.
